title: Driver Onboarding | BackOfficeFleet
html:
Driver readiness

Carry onboarding evidence into the first assignment decision.

BOF connects fleet-defined onboarding records, acknowledgements, training evidence, requests, review states, exceptions, owners, and readiness handoff.

Take the Assessment →

Source record

Application and identity records, credentials, policy acknowledgements, training evidence, equipment or role assignment, and fleet-specific requirements.

Review path

The record is checked for required items, dates, missing fields, current versions, acknowledgements, unresolved questions, and responsible owner.

Decision-ready output

An onboarding readiness state with supporting evidence, open items, clearance condition, owner, and assignment handoff.

How the work moves

The record keeps the exception, owner, and consequence visible.

The operating effect of an incomplete onboarding record is visible to the responsible team before work proceeds.

  1. 01

    Open the source record

    Application and identity records, credentials, policy acknowledgements, training evidence, equipment or role assignment, and fleet-specific requirements.

  2. 02

    Review the operating question

    The record is checked for required items, dates, missing fields, current versions, acknowledgements, unresolved questions, and responsible owner.

  3. 03

    Name the exception and owner

    Unresolved evidence is assigned to a responsible person with a clear request, review state, and condition that must be satisfied before the record moves.

  4. 04

    Carry the outcome forward

    An onboarding readiness state with supporting evidence, open items, clearance condition, owner, and assignment handoff. The operating effect of an incomplete onboarding record is visible to the responsible team before work proceeds.

Qualification

Administrative support stays inside a defined boundary.

BOF provides administrative support and does not act as employer, recruiter, legal adviser, safety authority, or qualification decision-maker.

  • Public screens, records, statuses, and integration examples are static or synthetic unless a page explicitly states an authorized live capability.
  • The fleet, carrier, employer, agency, customer, and qualified professionals retain their operating, legal, safety, regulatory, and financial authority.
  • BOF does not guarantee release, acceptance, compliance, payment, collection, savings, audit, safety, or financial outcomes.
  • The BOF assessment qualifies the record set, responsible owner, service boundary, intended output, and appropriate next action.
